reasoning: This is a fork/downstream of Kubeflow Notebooks v2. The core component is a Kubernetes operator (workspaces/controller) built with kubebuilder that reconciles Workspace and WorkspaceKind CRDs on the cluster. It follows the standard operator pattern: CRD definitions, a reconciliation controller, webhooks for validation, and kustomize-based deployment manifests. The repository also includes a backend-for-frontend (BFF) API server (workspaces/backend) and a web frontend (workspaces/frontend) that provide UI for managing workspaces, but the primary architectural pattern is a Kubernetes operator managing custom resources.
